name: THE FIZZ Hamburg Altona
address: Kieler Str. 3, Hamburg, Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg 22769
about:
The FIZZ Hamburg Altona is a comfortable student accommodation in Hamburg that offers 453 single and double studio apartments. This student apartment enjoys a perfect location in the trendy and vibrant Altona district; you are just a 14-minute cycle or a 16-minute transit ride away from the University of Hamburg. Just across the street is the REWE Ahmad Ahad supermarket, where students can conveniently get their daily needs, and excellent transport links are right on your doorstep. Best of all, THE FIZZ Hamburg Altona provides an entirely hassle-free tenancy: the rent is an all-inclusive package (covering water, electricity, heating, and high-speed broadband), meaning absolutely no hidden utility bills. Integrating living, shopping, and community functions, The FIZZ Hamburg creates opportunities for students to meet new friends and have an unforgettable living experience in the harbor city! FeaturesRoom Features
The FIZZ Hamburg features fully furnished single and double studio apartments, offering the perfect all-in living concept for the best time of your life. The studio rooms are clean, spacious, and bright, about 18-44㎡ according to the type. Each apartment is thoughtfully fully furnished with beds, desk chairs, desk lights, window curtains, rail system & pinboard, kitchen countertop, sink incl. fittings, kitchen worktop, cutlery system, and kitchen anti-splash counter. Rooms feature private or ensuite bathrooms and private kitchens, perfect for those who value privacy. If you are in Germany and would like to visit THE FIZZ Hamburg on-site, the manager will be happy to show you around your future home. Explore all available apartments and community areas with your own eyes.Community Amenities
THE FIZZ Hamburg has multifunctional community areas and a variety of services so you can fully enjoy the vibrant community life without stepping out of the apartment. You will create many wonderful memories here with friends from all over the world. Let's see what you can expect at THE FIZZ Hamburg:High-speed InternetOn-site gym, study rooms, and a gaming area with foosball and a consoleRooftop Terrace, courtyardOn-site Supermarket and DrugstoreSecurity & Services
All public areas are under 24/7 CCTV, and security personnel are on duty at night and on weekends.Free Equipment Hire: vacuum cleaner, iron and ironing board, PlayStation or board games, and more.House Management: support in the house, on-site maintenanceParcel Collection CounterEvents and activities are regularly organized, such as a cooking or movie night, a workshop, a yoga class, a lecture, etc. Plenty of opportunities to meet new friends.Safe bicycle storageFirst aid and fire protectionStarter-Set: bedding & towersLocation & What's Hot Nearby?
Do you love Scandinavia and the port city? Then THE FIZZ Hamburg should be your first choice! You'll never get bored in this vibrant metropolis with its wide range of cultural and leisure activities. Take a stroll along the Elbe, explore the many pier bridges, or experience the party life of St. Pauli. Relax in one of the many green parks along the Elbe. Moreover, THE FIZZ Hamburg is situated in the trendy Altona district, surrounded by many shops, restaurants, and bars.
Restaurants:
Enjoy traditional German dishes at Anno 1905, fantastic Italian at Il Cristallo, or grab a quick bite at Pamukkale Köz Schanze (Turkish).
Coffee:
Grab your morning flat white at local favorites like 44QM Café Neue, Blanco Coffee, or Kaffeekontor, all just a short walking distance away. 
Supermarkets:REWE: Literally right across the street (and within the building complex), making your daily grocery run effortless.Lidl, PENNY & Metro: All located within a short 5 to 10-minute walk for fantastic variety and budget-friendly shopping.
Local Hotspots:
Walk to Hamburg's most famous districts for an unbeatable mix of trendy boutiques, vibrant street art, and world-class nightlife. Don't forget to visit the iconic Alter Elbtunnel.Transportation
THE FIZZ Hamburg is loved by students for its convenient access to transportation lines and major colleges. It's not far from Sternschanze or the city center. Bus stops are right in front of the door, and the U-Bahn and S-Bahn are within walking distance.University of Hamburg: 3.2km from THE FIZZ Hamburg. You can reach the main campus in a quick 14-minute cycle or a 16-minute journey via public transport.Bus stops: The Stresemannstraße bus stop is literally a 1-minute walk from the front door, while the Kaltenkircher Platz stop is just 4 minutes away, providing rapid connections across the city. Holstenstraße S-Bahn Station (S1, S2, S3, S5): An incredibly short 5-minute walk (290m) away, linking you directly to the city centre, the main railway station (Hauptbahnhof), and Hamburg Airport.Emilienstraße U-Bahn Station (U2): Located about a 15–18 minute walk away, giving you access to the underground network for wider city exploration.

about: Are you looking for a student apartment in Hamburg? With us you will find 451 options, all of them high-quality and smartly furnished – with our all-in living concept there is something for everyone. Our student residence THE FIZZ offers self-sufficient living and friendly community all in one: Meet your new roommates in versatile shared community areas, such as on the rooftop terrace, in the cinema or in the community kitchen. Thanks to its excellent location, it is not far to the main train station, the Landungsbrücken or the Deichtor promenades.
